note: Provenance for inst/fixtures/places/programarea_gaa.json. That file is SHARED with the atlas repo and sha256-pinned there, so its bytes must not change; this sidecar lives in inst/gates/ instead and records which release's Program-Area vintage the outline was traced from.
why: The vintage is not incidental. v7's Program-Area layer (ply_programareas_2026_v7) has 14,256 zone_cell rows for GAA and v9's has 14,238, so asserting this fixture's cell count against v7 is wrong BY CONSTRUCTION, not by a bug in either. The tracing gate compares the loaded release's zone.tbl with source_zone_tbl and SKIPS assertion (c) with a reason when they differ.
